claim.quote: With an expected total background of 0.72 cpd/kg/keV, SABRE South can test the DAMA/LIBRA signal with 5$\sigma$ discovery or 3$\sigma$ exclusion after two years of data taking.

name: The SABRE South Technical Design Report Executive Summary
notes: A design projection (result_type technology_milestone), not a measured result.

summary.plain: The technical design report summary of SABRE South: seven ultra-pure NaI(Tl) crystals in a liquid-scintillator veto, with a muon veto above, designed to test DAMA/LIBRA's signal from the Southern Hemisphere. The reach is a design projection.
summary.technical: TDR executive summary (JINST 20, T04001): seven NaI(Tl) crystals (35 or 50 kg) in copper enclosures with R11065 PMTs in an 11.6 kL LAB veto with at least 18 R5912 PMTs, eight EJ-200 muon-veto modules; the veto should suppress the background by 27% in 1-6 keV; expected background 0.72 cpd/kg/keV.

title: The SABRE South Technical Design Report Executive Summary
why_it_matters: It is the design document on which the assembly at SUPL is based.
